notes.title: 2023/01/11 update
notes.content:
1. Some optimizations have been made, now you don't need to wait too long to enter the game
2. Many people hate the night too much, so the night is not so long now, and the small island in the distance can be clearly seen.
3. Brother Skull is too annoying, so we decided to eliminate some of them, greatly reducing the difficulty of travel

---
In the days to come, we will continue to update and improve, thank you everyone
